cap: Vaginal tumors are placed by age and exposure. A girl under 5 with a grape-like, bleeding mass has sarcoma botryoides, whose small round blue cells stain for desmin and myogenin. A young woman exposed to diethylstilbestrol (DES) in utero can have vaginal adenosis, which rarely progresses to clear cell adenocarcinoma. In older women, squamous carcinoma in the vagina has usually spread from the cervix.
